terra.problem: The text does not say how far the men traveled or why they chose the people they asked.
The suggested reason for taking the question to the priests and prophets is not given in the text.
The text identifies priests of the house of the LORD, but does not say the priests and prophets were at the house when asked.
The passage does not establish that no committee was involved.
The claim that kings had plenty to say back then is not established by the passage.
It comments on the question as a possible trick and assumes what the baker was expecting.
It gives a reason God named the four groups that the text does not provide.
The passage does not say that everyone in the four named groups already has less.
Blame and oppress are not close in sound, so the observation is inaccurate.
Nations they had not known are not necessarily places they had never seen or places far from everything familiar.
The passage does not say how far away the unfamiliar nations were.
Saying there is no joke comments on how Papa Dorin is telling the passage.
Saying he will keep it simple comments on how Papa Dorin is telling the passage.
